content.text: {"grade": 5, "complete": false, "main_gap": "The central quadratic estimate (7) is asserted with 'details omitted' — no derivation of the key inequality |d(y)-d(t)| \u2264 (y-t)^2/(4 min{t,y}) is given.", "errors": [{"description": "The crux of the proof, estimate (7), is stated without derivation. It is in fact obtainable in a few lines from the AM\u2013GM half alone (expanding (t+y+2c)^2 \u2265 4(t+c)(y+b) gives (t-y)^2 + 4(t+c)(c-b) \u2265 0), but as written the main lemma is unproved.", "quote": "Squaring the lower and the upper inequality, rearranging, and using \\(b,c\\ge0\\) (standard; details omitted) yields"}, {"description": "Minor inaccuracy in the same step: only the lower (AM\u2013GM) inequality is needed; the claim that both are squared and that b,c\u22650 is used is misleading/unnecessary, and no indication is given of which manipulation produces the asymmetric min{t,y} denominator (it comes from swapping the roles of t and y).", "quote": "Squaring the lower and the upper inequality"}], "notes": "Correct answer f(x)=x+C, C\u22650. Substitution x=f(y), the iterate law f^n(t)=t+nd(t), positivity forcing d\u22650, the telescoping argument and the converse verification are all correct and cleanly presented; only the key estimate's proof is missing."}
